keyframes_css: @keyframes auraAmbientDriftOne { 0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); } 35% { transform: translate3d(4vw, 3vh, 0) scale(1.06); } 70% { transform: translate3d(-2vw, 5vh, 0) scale(0.98); } }

@keyframes auraAmbientDriftTwo { 0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); } 40% { transform: translate3d(-4vw, -3vh, 0) scale(1.08); } 75% { transform: translate3d(3vw, -5vh, 0) scale(0.96); } }
